statement_map.email_excerpt: You wanted the autoresponder email to reach the leads coming in from your form, who were arriving but not receiving it.
Following our guidance, you turned on the autoresponder option in your form settings and saved it, and the email from your test form submission arrived.
We explained that the email can sometimes land in spam, so verifying your sender domain is a good idea, and that you can do this in the email domain section of your settings.
Verify your sender domain in the email domain section of your settings (tomorrow morning, as you mentioned).
